intro.say: Let's learn left and right! Your left hand can make a letter L.

rounds.say: Left is this way, and right is that way. Point both ways with your hands!
rounds.caption: left ⬅️  ➡️ right

rounds.say: Hold up both hands with palms away from you. Your left thumb and finger make an L, for left!
rounds.caption: L is for left

options.why: That one points right.
That one points up.

rounds.explain: This arrow points to the left side.

options.why: That one points down.
That one points left.

rounds.explain: This arrow points to the right side.

rounds.ask: The worm wants the pear. Which way should it go?

options.label: left
options.why: The apple is on the left. The pear is the other way.

rounds.explain: The pear is on the right of the worm, so it goes right.

rounds.ask: The dog wants its bone. Which way should it go?

options.label: right
options.why: Look again: the bone is on the other side.

rounds.explain: The bone is on the left of the dog, so it goes left.

rounds.ask: Which fruit is at the left end of the row?

options.why: The grapes are at the right end.
The banana is in the middle.

rounds.explain: The strawberry is first on the left.

intro.say: Let's learn to turn! A quarter turn, a half turn and a whole turn.

rounds.say: Face up. Make a quarter turn to the right, like a clock hand, and now you face right.
rounds.caption: quarter turn right

rounds.say: A half turn spins you round to face the other way. A whole turn takes you all the way back to the start.
rounds.caption: half turn · whole turn

rounds.ask: You face up. Make a quarter turn right. Which way do you face now?

options.why: That would be a half turn.
That would be a quarter turn left.

rounds.explain: A quarter turn right from up makes you face right.

rounds.ask: You face right. Make a half turn. Which way now?

options.why: That is only a quarter turn.
That is a whole turn.

rounds.explain: A half turn makes you face the opposite way, so now you face left.

rounds.ask: You face up. Make a whole turn. Which way now?

options.why: That is only a half turn.
That is only a quarter turn.

rounds.explain: A whole turn goes all the way round, back to facing up.

rounds.ask: You face up. Make a quarter turn LEFT. Which way now?

options.why: That is a quarter turn right.
That is a half turn.

rounds.explain: A quarter turn left from up makes you face left.

rounds.ask: How many quarter turns make one whole turn?

options.why: Two quarter turns make a half turn.
Three quarter turns are not quite all the way round.

rounds.explain: Four quarter turns take you all the way round.

intro.say: Let's follow directions to find the treasure! Listen for steps and turns.

rounds.say: Directions tell us how many steps and which way. The turtle takes 4 steps right to reach the strawberry.
rounds.caption: 4 steps right ➡️

rounds.ask: How many steps right does the bunny need to reach the carrot?

options.why: Count every step, landing on the carrot.
Count each square, then the carrot.

rounds.explain: Two empty squares and then the carrot make 3 steps.
rounds.hint: Count each hop, landing on the carrot.

rounds.ask: Which directions take the mouse to the mushroom?

options.label: 4 steps left
options.why: Count again, landing on the mushroom.

options.label: 5 steps right
options.why: The mushroom is on the left of the mouse.

rounds.explain: The mushroom is on the left, 5 hops away.

rounds.ask: Start facing up. Make quarter turns to the right, one at a time. Put the arrows in order.
rounds.explain: Each quarter turn right goes up, right, down, then left, like a clock.

rounds.ask: Sam faces the door. He makes a quarter turn right, and another quarter turn right. What does he face now?

options.label: the door
options.why: Two quarter turns make a half turn.

rounds.explain: Two quarter turns make a half turn, so he faces the opposite way.

rounds.ask: You face right. Make three quarter turns to the left. Which way now?

options.why: That is after just one turn.
That is after two turns.

rounds.explain: Right, then up, then left, then down.
rounds.hint: Turn one quarter at a time.

rounds.ask: You make two quarter turns right, then two quarter turns left. Which way do you face?

options.label: other way
options.why: The left turns undo the right turns.

options.label: sideways
options.why: Two turns each way cancel out.

rounds.explain: The two left turns undo the two right turns, so you are back where you started.
